purpose.summary: Replace the bounded regtest service's invalidation-ticket backlog with a compact ordered frontier, preserving native publication fences and strict component queue controls.
scope: Direct child of the published PR57 head bba9361; that parent remains pending integration and is not assumed to be main.
Four compiled host/test paths, a clean public catchup client and exact source/build projection, policy, tests and CI changes only.
Keep accepted/completed counters instead of historical notification tickets in the continuous service; retain the strict fixture deque and overflow refusal.
Preserve source/generation/epoch/readiness laws, native callback nonblocking metadata work and joined shutdown; report the first fixed failure reason before drain.
Add five exact fresh-process native leaves totaling72 assertions, then three runtime repetitions of300 rapid native blocks with existing ALP/plugin oracles and same-index reopen.
Retain all prior five-profile matrices, case bodies, assertion counts, deadlines, separate clients and historical evidence records.
exclusions: No upstream indexer, ALP parser/builder, plugin engine, dependency, consensus, activation or default change.
No widened native capture/reorg/storage budget, failed-root adoption, automatic wipe/rebuild, arbitrary plugin, new listener or service capability.
No incoming private report, raw operational output, history, binary, operator data, server/deployment, desktop integration or proof promotion.

The first local policy regression batch exceeded its180-second per-file driver budget in the startup-policy self-test and was interrupted during the following file. Narrow reuse let startup-policy pass136s, but a second batch reached180s in recovery-policy and was interrupted. This is distinct from daemon startup. Shared reuse of full immutable Git-object byte reads and earlier historical rejection avoid redundant subprocess work; no current file, mutable ref, signature, diff, ancestry or validation success is cached and no runtime deadline or rejection class is relaxed.

Review found that the new runner's serial cleanup could stop at the first owner failure and skip later owners. A synthetic regression failed before correction. Cleanup now attempts every owner, retains the root on any unverified cleanup and refuses a passing report; failure at either owner is covered without extending any native/daemon deadline.
